# Tiny Fixture

A deliberately small repository with a known shape, used by the golden tests.

Every number asserted in `tests/test_golden.py` is derivable by hand from the
files in this directory.

## Layout

- `alpha/` has its own README, so it must become a Town Hall district.
- `beta/` has no README, a notebook, a data file and a test directory.
- `delta gamma/` has a space in its name, which must survive path handling.
